verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own desktop documentation has dedicated pages titled 'Encrypt your disk with TPM', 'Configure hardware-backed disk encryption' and 'Recover data from hardware-backed disk encryption', so the product itself ships TPM-backed disk encryption. The evidence is only table-of-contents titles, with no content detail or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: details of setup steps and hardware/version requirements, documented limitations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
